applicable_rules: Architecture section 7.1 requires one KnowledgeCapsuleV2, one KnowledgeRetriever, and one KnowledgeSnapshot.

Architecture section 7.2 requires a compact KnowledgeDecisionView for the model while full source locators, field provenance, exclusions, candidate sets, index abstracts, and security events remain in the replayable Snapshot.
Architecture section 7.3 requires capability knowledge to carry valid_from, valid_until, model, mode, aspect scope, and source summary; a single failure cannot become knowledge.
Architecture section 14 and amendment ADR-016 require the owning upstream work package to be invalidated when a downstream audit finds a frozen artifact boundary deficient.

finding: A3 cannot implement the one canonical K1/K2 retrieval boundary with the current A1 domain contract. The existing service declares duplicate KnowledgeStage, KnowledgeDecisionView, and KnowledgeSnapshot classes instead of consuming mode_p_vnext.domain.knowledge. Its self-hashed service snapshot is therefore a parallel authority that cannot be wrapped as the canonical KNOWLEDGE_SNAPSHOT ArtifactEnvelope. The A1 snapshot has selected IDs, exclusions, conflicts, index digest, and input digest, but has no candidate-set/provenance record; KnowledgeCapsuleV2 has no field-level provenance or applicability validity/scope fields required for capability knowledge.

code_evidence.evidence: The service defines KnowledgeStage, KnowledgeDecisionView, and KnowledgeSnapshot locally, while importing only KnowledgeCapsuleV2 from domain. The local snapshot carries content_sha256 and to_dict(), creating a second incompatible persistence authority.

Canonical KnowledgeSnapshot has no candidate-set or field-provenance record and KnowledgeCapsuleV2 contains only capsule_id/category/claims/source_refs/confidence, so it cannot represent the architecture-required validity and model/mode/aspect scope of promoted capability knowledge.

The historical metadata candidate carries model/mode/aspect and valid_until but no valid_from; its legacy execution switch is approved:true. A3 may reuse it only behind a canonical adapter, not elevate it to the v2.1 authority.
All seven tests import the service-local KnowledgeStage and never assert identity with the A1 canonical domain classes, so 7 passing tests do not prove the one-authority invariant.

root_cause: A1 froze a minimal domain schema before the complete architecture section 7 replay/provenance contract was mechanically checked. The prior A3 implementation filled those missing fields by duplicating domain classes inside its allowed service file instead of reopening the upstream domain owner.

rejected_workarounds.option: Keep the service-local knowledge classes and call them adapters
rejected_workarounds.reason: They have different fields and hashing semantics, so they are a second authority rather than an adapter.

rejected_workarounds.option: Store candidate/provenance data in unconstrained conflict or exclusion mappings
rejected_workarounds.reason: That would hide typed snapshot data in semantically unrelated escape hatches and would not freeze a replay port.
A3 does not own domain paths; ADR-016 requires rework by A1.

required_upstream_repair: Invalidate completed A2 first because it depends on A1, then invalidate A1; do not alter completed state manually.

Extend A1 canonical knowledge schemas with immutable candidate/provenance records and applicability fields including valid_from, valid_until, model, mode, aspect, and source summary where capability scope is present.

Make the canonical KnowledgeSnapshot sufficient to preserve the candidate set, selection/exclusion reasons, source provenance, index abstract, security-event digests, and replay input binding as a KNOWLEDGE_SNAPSHOT ArtifactEnvelope payload.
Add A1 mechanical tests that prohibit duplicate vNext knowledge authority classes outside domain and prove the capability-scope invariants.
After A1 and A2 are accepted again, re-claim A3 and make KnowledgeRetriever consume only canonical domain KnowledgeStage, KnowledgeDecisionView, and KnowledgeSnapshot.

tests_observed.interpretation: Insufficient: the tests cover the duplicated local types and therefore do not prove the architecture's single canonical knowledge authority.

tests_observed.result: Mechanical authority audit finds same-named knowledge types in both the canonical domain module and A3 service module.
